employees.tempPasswordHint: Hand this password to the employee. It cannot be recovered after you close this page.
employees.allocHint: Leave this employee already has on day one, credited once. For a new hire this is normally 0 — the monthly accrual below builds the balance up. Use it to carry a balance over from the paper records. It is added on top of accrual and is not limited by the yearly cap below.
employees.allocWarn: Employee created, but setting leave balance failed:
employees.policyHint: What this employee earns each month, added to their current balance. Accrual starts from the current Jalali month — not the hire date — so someone added mid-year earns only the remaining months of that year.
employees.policyAnnualCapHint: The most that can be earned in one Jalali year — the employee's annual entitlement. 0 means no cap. Only monthly accrual counts toward it; balances set by hand do not.
employees.policyCarryCapHint: The most that survives into the next Jalali year. At Nowruz anything above this is forfeited. 0 means unused leave is lost each year.
employees.policyWarn: Employee created, but saving the accrual policy failed:

modes.title: Import mode
modes.addHint: Create the people who are not in the app yet. A personnel number that already exists is an error. Nothing else changes.

modes.replace: Replace — the file is the new source of truth
modes.replaceHint: Add & update, plus: people not in the file are deactivated or kept (you choose), and unused empty departments are deleted. Admin accounts are never touched.
modes.overwriteBalancesHint: Set each updated person's annual balance to the file's value as of the balance date. Leave recorded in the app after that date is not re-counted.
modes.replaceConfirmBody: {create} will be created, {update} updated, {deactivate} deactivated, and {deleteDepartments} empty departments deleted. This runs as one step; nothing changes if it fails.

special_leave.label: Leave outside the list

finance.label: Finance

people.label: Employee records
people.description: Read: the employee list and records. Allowed: edit name, hire date, department, manager, title; deactivate.

reset_employee_password.label: Reset employee passwords

role_manager.label: Manager role
role_manager.description: Give or remove the Manager role.

role_assign.description: Give or remove read-only roles within your own access. Sensitive roles, HR and Finance are admin-only. HR holders can assign only Employee and Manager.

personal_info.label: Personal information
personal_info.description: Read: view and export. Allowed: correct and import.

clearance.label: Clearance forms
clearance.description: Read: every form. Allowed: file, edit, cancel; default rows.

departments.label: Departments
departments.description: Read: departments and members. Allowed: create, rename, set manager.

leave_balances.label: Leave balances
leave_balances.description: Read: anyone's balances and accrual policy. Allowed: opening balances, corrections, policy.

leave_accrual.label: Monthly accrual
leave_accrual.description: Post the monthly accrual for everyone.

leave_requests.label: Approvals — request review
leave_requests.description: Read: review all requests and forms on Approvals. Allowed: cancellation rights under existing rules. Approval authority is determined separately by the approval chain.

approval_steps.label: Approval steps
approval_steps.description: Read: view the steps. Allowed: add, remove, reorder, turn on and off, and decide whether their order binds.

work_settings.label: Work week
work_settings.description: Weekly days off, working hours, hourly cap.

holidays.label: Official holidays
holidays.description: Add, edit, delete and upload holidays.

approval_delegate.label: Approval delegation
approval_delegate.description: Choose your own approval delegate. This does not grant role editing or access to other people’s delegation settings.

travel_booking.label: Travel booking
travel_booking.description: See approved errands that need travel booking and the traveller details needed to book; record the transport, ticket and hotel costs, and the amount lost after a cancellation.

finance_forms.label: View/print work-errand forms
finance_forms.description: View complete work-errand forms listed in Finance, including reasons and signatures. Requires Finance access; does not grant approval authority.

edit_leave_daily.label: Edit daily leave
edit_leave_daily.description: Change the dates or times of an approved request of this type. Switching between daily and hourly needs both permissions.

edit_leave_hourly.label: Edit hourly leave
edit_leave_hourly.description: Change the dates or times of an approved request of this type. Switching between daily and hourly needs both permissions.

edit_errand_daily.label: Edit daily work trips
edit_errand_daily.description: Change the dates or times of an approved request of this type. Switching between daily and hourly needs both permissions. Includes the per diem.

edit_errand_hourly.label: Edit hourly work errands
edit_errand_hourly.description: Change the dates or times of an approved request of this type. Switching between daily and hourly needs both permissions.

edit_requests_own.label: Edit own requests
edit_requests_own.description: Lets the holder edit their own approved requests, for the types they may edit.

sales.label: Sales module
sales.description: Open the hidden ERP · Sales module. Read: records, items, deadlines and activity (no prices or guarantee details). Edit: create and change records, move stages, documents and deadlines.

sales_prices.label: Sales prices
sales_prices.description: Read: unit prices, our total price, contract value, winning bid and past quotes. Edit: type them. Without this, prices never reach the person.

sales_bonds.label: Guarantees and payments
sales_bonds.description: Read: guarantee details (amount, bank, number, dates) and payments received. Edit: record and update them (finance). Guarantee amounts reveal the contract value.

sales_decide.label: Bid decision and result
sales_decide.description: Decide bid / no bid, record won / lost / cancelled, close and reopen records.

sales_reports.label: Sales reports
sales_reports.description: The Reports page of the Sales module. Price history also needs Sales prices.

sales_settings.label: Sales settings and import
sales_settings.description: Change stages, extra fields and numbering; import the contract ledger and remove imports.

project_items.label: Items and parts

form.rfpIntro: A new request to bid on. Details can be added later.
form.contractIntro: An order that did not go through an RFP here.
form.editIntro: Change the details of this record.

move.intro: Choose the next stage and who takes the record.
move.ownerHint: Leave as is to keep the current person.
move.validityHint: Days the offer stays valid; its end becomes a deadline.

decide.intro: Does the company bid on this RFP?

resultDialog.wonHint: A won record continues as a contract.
resultDialog.pricesHidden: You do not see prices; the winning bid you type is still saved.

event.edit: {count, plural, one {# field changed} other {# fields changed}}

items.hint: One row per item of this record. Open a row to add its parts. Numbers are given on save and never reused.
items.toggle: Show or hide the parts of {code}
items.removeBody: Its number will not be used again.
items.removeBodyChildren: {count, plural, one {# row under it is removed too.} other {# rows under it are removed too.}} Their numbers will not be used again.
items.columnIntro: Show a column at this level, or make a new one.
items.newColumnHint: A new column can be used on other records too. Do not put prices in it: everyone who sees items sees it.

documents.hint: The proposal package. No file is kept here: record who prepares each document and where it is.
documents.name: Document
documents.whereHint: e.g. whose laptop, or a shared folder.

bond.title: Guarantees
bond.summaryHint: Guarantee details are for finance. You see where each one stands.
bond.dialogHint: An expiry date becomes a deadline for this record.
bond.expiresHint: Needed to be warned before it runs out.

payment.title: Payments received
payment.dialogHint: Money received from the customer for this contract.

deadline.overdueBy: {days, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}
deadline.dialogHint: A date someone must not miss on this record.
deadline.recordHint: Proposal, bond, validity, guarantee and delivery dates appear here by themselves; other dates can be added.

home.waiting: {count, plural, one {# sales deadline needs attention} other {# sales deadlines need attention}}

reports.resultsHint: Bids decided in this system. Contracts imported from the ledger are not counted: they have no lost bids beside them.
reports.noResults: No bid has a result yet.
reports.priceHistoryHint: Prices as they stood when each proposal was submitted. Search by type, size, rating or description.
reports.deadlinesHint: Old dates that came in with the ledger import are left out.

settings.label: Settings sections
settings.stagesIntro: Each kind of record moves through its own stages. Rename, add, reorder or retire them here; a stage that has records is retired, never deleted.
settings.stageKindHint: Reports group stages by this, whatever they are named.
settings.stageActionHint: What the system does at this stage.
settings.ownerRoleHint: Suggested as the next person in charge.
settings.requiredHint: Fields that must have a value before a record moves forward out of this stage.
settings.stageDialogHint: Names are shown in the language of the reader.
settings.fieldsIntro: Extra columns for records and for item rows. Values are kept when a field is retired.
settings.typeFixed: The type cannot change after creation.
settings.fieldDialogHint: An extra column the company wants to keep.
settings.fieldPriceWarning: Everyone who can open Sales sees extra fields. Do not use them for prices.
settings.nextRecordNoHint: Must be above every existing number.
settings.warnDaysHint: A deadline this close is marked amber.
settings.validityDaysHint: Suggested when a proposal is submitted.
settings.docTemplateHint: One document per line. Added to every new RFP.

currencies.intro: The currencies a record, guarantee or price can use. A code is permanent once saved; deactivate a currency to hide it from the lists (old records keep showing it). Decimals only change how amounts are shown.
currencies.dialogHint: The code cannot be changed after saving. The symbol is shown after amounts; without one the name is shown.
currencies.codeHint: Letters and digits, up to 10, e.g. TMN
currencies.deleteBody: Only a currency that no record uses can be deleted.
currencies.readOnly: Only people who manage Sales settings can change currencies.

import.intro: Bring the contract ledger (the Excel file with one row per record) into the system. The file is read on this computer and is not stored anywhere.
import.step1: Download the template: it has the exact column names.
import.step2: Paste your rows under the headers and save the file.
import.step3: Choose the file, check the preview, then import. Importing again updates the same records.
import.notXlsx: This is not an Excel (.xlsx) file.
import.noHeader: No sheet has a header row starting with "Rec". Use the template.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 20 MB.
import.tooManyRows: More than {max} rows. Split the file.
import.missing: Columns not found in the file
import.unknownTitle: Columns the system does not know
import.unknownHint: Tick a column to keep it as an extra record field; the rest are ignored.
import.peopleHint: Match each name in the ledger to an employee. A name left unmatched is kept as text.

issue.rec_missing: No record number: row left out
issue.rec_duplicate: Repeated record number: row left out
issue.euro_as_rial: Too large for euros: imported as Rial

skip.exists_in_app: a record with this number was created here; not overwritten
skip.duplicate: the same number appears earlier in the file

import.batchesHint: Removing an import deletes the records it created that nobody has changed since. Use it to clear test data before importing the real file.
import.removeBody: {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} created by this import will be deleted for good, with their items, guarantees and deadlines. {kept, plural, =0 {} one {# record changed here is kept.} other {# records changed here are kept.}}

inquiry.intro: Bring the inquiry register (one row per inquiry, every bid won, lost or not answered) into the system. The file is read on this computer and is not stored anywhere.
inquiry.step1: Export the register from Google Sheets or Excel as .csv or .xlsx, or start from the template.
inquiry.step2: Choose the file and check the preview: companies that look the same, the people, and the rows that need a look.
inquiry.step3: Import. Importing a newer file later updates the same records by record number.
inquiry.notReadable: This file could not be read as .csv or .xlsx.
inquiry.noHeader: No header row with "Record No." was found. Use the template.
inquiry.separators: {count, plural, one {# separator row skipped} other {# separator rows skipped}}
inquiry.cutoff: Rows received before this date are archived
inquiry.cutoffHint: Without a result, an older inquiry goes to Archived; a newer one stays open.
inquiry.loserNote: {count, plural, one {# signed contract has} other {# signed contracts have}} a price under LOSER. They stay contracts; check with the client what LOSER means.
inquiry.similarHint: Choose whether these spellings are one company. Same company: every row uses the chosen name.
inquiry.peopleHint: Match each name to an employee. Unmatched names are kept as text. Y / N values are kept as a note.
inquiry.stopped: Stopped. The import is incomplete; remove it from Earlier imports or import again.
inquiry.done: Imported: {created} new, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped. Won {won} · lost {lost} · no bid {no_bid} · cancelled {cancelled} · open {open} · archived {archived}.
inquiry.merged: {count, plural, one {# spelling merged automatically (only capitals or spaces differ)} other {# spellings merged automatically (only capitals or spaces differ)}}

stagePage.label: Stages
stagePage.nextIntro: Move the record to {stage} and choose who takes it.
stagePage.discard: You have changes that are not submitted. Discard them?
stagePage.viewOnly: This stage has not been reached yet. You can look, but not change it.
stagePage.closedOnly: This record is closed. Only someone who decides bids can change it.
stagePage.readOnly: You can read this record but not change it.
stagePage.listsSaveAsYouGo: Rows below are saved as you go; the fields above wait for Submit.
stagePage.decideOnly: Only someone who decides bids can make this decision.
stagePage.resultOnly: Only someone who decides bids can record the result.
stagePage.reopenIntro: Choose the stage the record goes back to.
stagePage.noPage: This stage has no page of its own. Its required fields are below.
stagePage.noFields: Nothing to fill in on this stage.
stagePage.pricedByItems: Our total price is the sum of the item prices (Pricing items).

customerCombo.newHint: Check the list below first: a company is added once, then picked.
customerCombo.name: Company name

customers.title: Customers
customers.mergeBody: {count, plural, one {# record moves} other {# records move}} to the chosen company. {name} is then removed. This cannot be undone.

names.title: Name matching
names.intro: Match the names an import brought in to the people and companies in the system. Each match is saved and used by every later import.
names.peopleHint: In-charge names from the imported files. Pick the employee each name means; every record with that name gets that person.
names.name: Name in the file
names.saved: {count, plural, one {# record updated} other {# records updated}}
names.onlyBatch: Only names from the import of {date}
names.dupHint: Companies that are probably the same. Merging moves their records and remembers the spelling for later imports.
names.mergeBody: The records of {names} move to {name}, and these spellings are remembered for later imports. This cannot be undone.
names.forgetBody: Later imports will no longer turn "{alias}" into {target}. Records keep their current values.

products.intro: The product families your company sells. Picking one on an item row fills that row's empty cells with the product's default values; rows already saved are never changed when a product is edited.
products.addHint: Name it in both languages. Add its columns and defaults on the next page.
products.name: Name
products.readOnly: Only people who manage Sales settings can change products.
products.columnsHint: The item columns this product uses. A default is copied into an item row only where that cell is empty. Picking the product also shows these columns on the record.
products.newColumnHint: A new column joins the company's item column library and can be used on other products and records. Do not put prices in it: everyone who sees items sees it. Choice lists are set in Settings.
products.deleteBody: Only a product that no item uses can be deleted. Deactivate it instead to hide it from the picker.
products.usedHint: {count, plural, one {# item row uses this product.} other {# item rows use this product.}}

files.hint: Any file type, up to 50 MB each. Everyone who can see this record can download its files.
files.name: File
files.deleteBody: The file {name} will be deleted and cannot be recovered.
files.receivedHint: Upload the RFP documents in Files

error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
error.notFound: The record or file was not found.
error.length: The browser did not send the file size.
error.tooLarge: The file is larger than 50 MB.
